## Overview

Lake Los Carneros (LLC) in Goleta is the field site for week 4. LLC is one example of a built green space that provides wildlife habitat and space for human recreation. In this independent field trip option, you will visit and conduct a field observation at _four_ parks in Isla Vista. Choose this option if you are interested in urban planning and the incorporation of green spaces in residential areas.

You will turn in a **hard copy** of this assignment in class. If you don't want to turn in your entire notebook, do this assignment _separately_ from your notebook. 

## Locations

Choose _one_ park to visit from each of the regions listed on the Isla Vista Recreation & Park District [website](https://ivparks.org/isla-vista-district-parks/).

- Estero Park

## Assignment overview

:::{.callout-tip title="Don't forget your metadata!"}

:::

### a. Create a species account.

Walk around the park and identify as many species as possible to characterize the park's habitat. Note that this will differ based on the park! 

### b. Conduct an observation.

At one park, choose an organism, species, or interaction to focus on observing.

Spend _at least_ 20 minutes on your observation.

### c. Write your post-field day reflection.

In your reflection, compare the four parks you visited with LLC. Discuss how they compare in:

- size
- diversity of habitat types
- species richness (i.e. number of species)
- community composition (i.e. species present)

Discuss _why_ you may have observed any similarities or differences (e.g. shared habitats, common plants, time of day of visit).

Lastly, discuss the benefits or costs of these parks to nearby residents. Use specific examples from what you saw at each park to support your claim. 

## Checklist

By the due date, you should have:

- [ ] metadata for your field day(s) at all parks
- [ ] a species account for a "Central Downtown Park"
- [ ] a species account for a "Neighborhood Park"
- [ ] a species account for a "Bluff-Top Park"
- [ ] a species account for a "Natural Open Space"
- [ ] an observation at one of your four parks
- [ ] a post-field day reflection for your time at all parks 

You will turn in a **hard copy** of your species accounts, observations, and reflections in class on Tuesday the 27th of October.
